_note: Travel tips articles. Add one object here, create tips/<id>/index.html, then run python3 tools/i18n/build.py. The hub, sitemap, language shells and 'Read before you go' cards are generated from this list. 'guides' is the list of guide folder names that should show the card.

articles.title: Petra tips: which route to take, and how long you need
articles.teaser: The official main trail, two serious climbs, the Royal Tombs and a quieter canyon to the north.
articles.imageAlt: Al-Khazneh, the Treasury, at the end of the Siq in Petra

articles.title: What to do in Kuşadası
articles.teaser: Ephesus, the town of Selçuk, the House of the Virgin Mary, Şirince, and a classic longer day to Priene, Miletus and Didyma.
articles.imageAlt: Marble facade of the Library of Celsus along the street of Ephesus

articles.title: What to do in Rome
articles.teaser: The Colosseum and the Forum, the Pantheon, a free walk past Navona, Trevi and the Spanish Steps, the Vatican, and a day trip to Tivoli.
articles.imageAlt: The Colosseum in Rome seen from outside in warm afternoon light

articles.title: What to do in Paris
articles.teaser: The Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, Notre-Dame and the Sainte-Chapelle, the Musée d’Orsay, Montmartre, the Arc de Triomphe, and a day at Versailles.
articles.imageAlt: The Eiffel Tower rising above the Champ de Mars in Paris

articles.title: What to do in Istanbul
articles.teaser: Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque and the Hippodrome, the Basilica Cistern, Topkapı Palace, the Grand Bazaar, Galata Tower and the Bosphorus.
articles.imageAlt: The dome and minarets of Hagia Sophia in Sultanahmet, Istanbul
